document: Frozen common evidence-only method for cycle, collision, and accuracy evaluation
purpose: Give every architecture the same static inputs, units, coverage boundary, evidence record, and decision rule without asserting an uncalibrated common dynamic host or automatic engineering pass.

sharedInputs.geometry: inputs/fixed-geometry.json exact CSG and grasp coordinates
sharedInputs.cell: inputs/cell-layout.json permitted envelope and keep-out definitions

canonicalInputByteSet.scope: The exact benchmark-owned byte set used by every motion, collision, and accuracy evidence record. It intentionally excludes this method and the neutral-handoff contract so the public digest has no circular dependency; those two documents are separately hash-bound packet inputs.
canonicalInputByteSet.canonicalization: Sort records by path using bytewise UTF-8 ascending order. For each record, append UTF-8 bytes of path, one 0x00 byte, lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of that exact file's raw bytes, and one 0x0A byte. inputDigest is lowercase SHA-256 of the resulting concatenation.

motion.coverage: segmentIds exactly covers every declared trajectory segment; payloadCaseIds exactly covers CASE-WP-A, CASE-WP-B, and CASE-WP-C.
motion.decision: Compare each reported cycle allocation against the 32 s target using submitted static kinematic, drive, and dwell evidence. A preflight arithmetic pass is never a feasibility pass.

collision.coverage: poseIds exactly covers all required poses; payloadCaseIds exactly covers all required cases; geometryReferenceIds exactly covers every fixed object/workpiece reference.
collision.decision: Assess the submitted neutral CAD and declared sampled/swept-volume method against the exact CSG/keep-outs. Record evidence-supported pass, fail, evaluator-unsupported, or evaluator-uncertain; do not infer collision freedom from the static handoff validator.

accuracy.coverage: poseIds and payloadCaseIds exactly cover the frozen sets; foundationReference is FND-ANCH-001; errorSources identify backlash, encoder/feedback, compliance, thermal, assembly/datum, and calibration contributions or explicitly justify their inapplicability.
accuracy.decision: Assess reproducibility of the submitted error model and applicability to the 0.20 mm design target. RSS arithmetic alone is not a repeatability qualification or physical certification.

calibrationBoundary.futureChangeRule: A future packet may add topology-aware automatic qualification only after frozen reference architectures, input transformations, limit laws, and calibration coverage are independently reviewed and published.

reviewDecisionRule: Use the same frozen inputs and record completeness check for every candidate. A result is pass only when submitted evidence supports the stated method at its declared fidelity; otherwise label design-failed, evaluator-unsupported, or evaluator-uncertain. No reviewer may substitute an undisclosed host model, controller setting, component rating, or calibration data.
